Class TowerInfoPanel

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
gui.ingame.TowerInfoPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class TowerInfoPanel extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
A JavaFX UI component that provides a detailed information and control panel for a specific Tower. *

This panel displays live statistics (damage dealt), targeting controls, branching upgrade paths, and selling options. It communicates directly with GameLogic to process transactions and state changes.
